trials.title: A Multicenter Open-Label Study of RMC-6236 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors Harboring Specific Mutations in RAS
trials.briefTitle: Study of RMC-6236 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors Harboring Specific Mutations in RAS

arms.label: Experimental: RMC-6236
arms.description:
Enrollment into dose exploration may be from any advanced solid tumor type with KRAS p.G12 mutations.

Enrollment into dose expansion/optimization may be from groups consisting of patients with a single histotype/genotype (for example, KRAS G12-mutated NSCLC, PDAC, CRC, RAS mutant NSCLC, Melanoma, gynecological cancer or other solid tumors not previously specified).

RAS mutant is defined as any nonsynonymous mutation of KRAS, NRAS, or HRAS at codons 12, 13, or 61 (G12, G13, or Q61)

primaryEndpoints: Incidence and severity of treatment-emergent Adverse Events (AEs) and serious AEs, including incidence and severity of findings in laboratory values and vital signs
Number of Participants with Dose-Limiting Toxicity (DLT)
secondaryEndpoints: Maximum Observed Blood Concentration (Cmax) of RMC-6236
Time to Reach Maximum Blood Concentration (Tmax) of RMC-6236
Area Under Blood Concentration Time Curve (AUC) of RMC-6236
Ratio of accumulation of RMC-6236 from a single dose to steady state with repeated dosing

trials.title: RASolute 302: A Phase 3 Multicenter, Open-label, Randomized Study of Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) Versus Investigator's Choice of Standard of Care Therapy in Patients With Previously Treated Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
trials.briefTitle: Phase 3 Study of Daraxonrasib (RMC-6236) in Patients With Previously Treated Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC)

arms.label: Investigator's choice of standard of care therapy
arms.description:
Patients randomized to Investigator's choice of standard of care chemotherapy will receive one of the following four treatments:

* Gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel (GnP)
* Oxaliplatin, leucovorin, irinotecan, and 5-FU (Modified FOLFIRINOX: mFOLFIRINOX)
* Liposomal irinotecan (Nal-IRI + 5-FU/LV)
* Oxaliplatin, leucovorin and 5-FU IV (FOLFOX)

primaryEndpoints: Progression free survival (PFS) in the RAS G12-mutant population
Overall survival (OS) in the RAS G12-mutant population
secondaryEndpoints: Objective response in the RAS G12 and all-patient populations
